recentItems.title: AAA TRIPLEMANIA LAS VEGAS: Lucha Libre AAA: Sept. 11, 2026
recentItems.description:
The biggest event in Mexican lucha libre, AAA Triplemania, takes over two spectacular nights! Night 1 comes to the MGM Grand in Las Vegas with huge matchups that will shape Night 2 in Mexico City and the rest of 2026 in AAA.

Rey Mysterio takes on Omos in a match featuring a special stipulation. Plus, La Parka puts the AAA Latin American Championship on the line against Mr. Iguana and Laredo Kid, while Los Perros del Mal battle Los Psycho Circus for the AAA Trios Championships.

Also, a new No. 1 Contender for the AAA Reina de Reinas Championship will be determined as Faby Apache, Roxanne Perez, Natalya, and La Hiedra collide for a future title opportunity.
